chafe.definition:
n. soreness and warmth caused by friction
v. become or make sore by or as if by rubbing
v. feel extreme irritation or anger
chafe.translation:
n. 擦伤, 气恼
v. 摩擦, 擦痛, 激怒

chafed.definition: s. painful from having the skin abraded
chafed.translation: v. 擦热（尤指皮肤）( chafe的过去式 ); 擦痛; 发怒; 惹怒

chafer.definition:
n. One who chafes.
n. A vessel for heating water; -- hence, a dish or pan.
n. A kind of beetle; the cockchafer. The name is also applied
   to other species; as, the rose chafer.
chafer.translation:
n. 金龟子
[建] 胎圈包布

chafes.definition:
n soreness and warmth caused by friction
n anger produced by some annoying irritation
v become or make sore by or as if by rubbing
v feel extreme irritation or anger
v cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations
v tear or wear off the skin or make sore by abrading
v cause friction
v warm by rubbing, as with the hands
chafes.translation: v. 擦热（尤指皮肤）( chafe的第三人称单数 ); 擦痛; 发怒; 惹怒

chaff.definition:
n. material consisting of seed coverings and small pieces of stem or leaves that have been separated from the seeds
n. foil in thin strips; ejected into the air as a radar countermeasure
chaff.translation:
n. 谷壳, 糠, 揶揄
